assertions: Essex will take Reading: the town will pass into Parliament's hands and Essex's army will gain possession of it
The town will be taken by surrender / delivery on terms, not by a successful storm or escalade of the walls
The governor, signified by Saturn lord of the 4th in his fall, is too weak to hold the town and will give it up / abandon his charge rather than fight to the last
The King will not relieve the town in time: the Sun, the King's significator, in the 7th in a fixed sign makes no effective rescue of the 4th house or its lord

The gain comes after a short delay and some difficulty, shown by the Moon void of course applying to Mars by a sextile that acts like a square in signs of long ascension — not an instant or effortless fall

Essex himself / his force is the stronger party despite Mars being in his fall: Mars angular in the 10th, in reception with the Moon near Regulus, is well fortified and his army remains besieging until the delivery
The delivery will be within days of the question, in the same siege operation concluding in April — the town is not held through a long prolonged siege
method: Classical horary astrology (Lilly tradition, whole-sign / classical significators as given in the input positions)
reasoning: Mars lord of the ascending Scorpio is Essex: angular in the 10th, well fortified and in mutual reception with the Moon near Regulus, outweighing Mars being in his fall. The town is the 4th (Aquarius) and its governor Saturn lord of the 4th in his fall — a holder too debilitated to sustain the place. The Sun, the King's significator, in the 7th in a fixed sign gives no timely relief application to save the 4th or Saturn. The Moon void of course delays the outcome and her application to Mars by sextile (counting as a square in signs of long ascension) shows the transfer is completed with difficulty, which fits delivery on terms rather than a clean assault; hence positive for Essex, by surrender, within the April siege timeframe (timing scale: days, by Moon's application to the querent-side significator Mars).
summary: Essex will take Reading, by surrender and delivery of the town from its weakened governor rather than by storm, after a short delay.
